AnalyticsSummary.description:
Spending for the current period so far, compared with the same span of the previous
period. All figures are SQL sums of the user's transactions (AGENTS.md §4.2).

change_pct.description: Whole percent change vs previous_total; null when previous_total is 0.
change_pct.title: Change Pct

compared_until.description: The previous window stops here: the current time of day on previous_end, so an unfinished today is compared like for like.
compared_until.title: Compared Until

AnalyticsSummary.title: AnalyticsSummary

client_id.description: A new UUID per photo; resending it returns the same receipt.
client_id.title: Client Id

image.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP photo of the receipt.
image.title: Image

BudgetAlert.description: A budget whose level just rose because of this change (near limit / exceeded).
BudgetAlert.title: BudgetAlert

BudgetImpact.description: A budget this transaction counts toward, for the period that contains it.
BudgetImpact.title: BudgetImpact

share_pct.description: Whole percent of the overall total (rounded half up).
share_pct.title: Share Pct

Confidence.description: Whole percents (0–100), shown as "Store 99% · Items 94% · Total 98%".
Confidence.title: Confidence

shopping_item.description: The list item for add_to_list (an existing one if it was already there).

est_price.description: Missing only: what you last paid for one purchase of it (null = unknown).
est_price.title: Est Price

engine.description: "ai" = worded by the model (numbers checked); "summary" = fixed template.
engine.title: Engine

need_more_data.description: Too little data for insights yet.
need_more_data.title: Need More Data

ListBudget.description: The food budget the list is checked against (Groceries budget, else overall).

percent_left_after.description: remaining_after as whole % of the limit.
percent_left_after.title: Percent Left After

ListBudget.title: ListBudget

MeUpdate.description: Fields a user may change on their profile. Role and consents are not editable.
MeUpdate.title: MeUpdate

suggestion.description: Restock reminders: the suggestion, so open ones can be answered here.

estimated_expiry.description: Only ever set by the user.
estimated_expiry.title: Estimated Expiry

confirmed.description: true = confirm the amount as it is.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

Preferences.description: Notification toggles and the budget alert threshold (Profile screen).

budget_alert_pct.description: Send a 'near limit' alert at this % of a budget.
budget_alert_pct.title: Budget Alert Pct

Preferences.title: Preferences

confidence.description: 0–1 heuristic consistency score (sample size × regularity of intervals), not a statistical probability; 0 when data is insufficient.
confidence.title: Confidence

purchase_count.description: Distinct days the product was bought.
purchase_count.title: Purchase Count

ReceiptConfirm.description: The user-checked receipt. Line totals are recomputed on the server.
ReceiptConfirm.title: ReceiptConfirm

ReceiptDraft.description: What OCR found. Nothing here is saved as a transaction until it is confirmed.
ReceiptDraft.title: ReceiptDraft

missing_cost.description: Sum of KNOWN prices of missing ingredients; see missing_unpriced_count.
missing_cost.title: Missing Cost

missing_cost.description: Sum of KNOWN prices of missing ingredients; see missing_unpriced_count.
missing_cost.title: Missing Cost

over_budget_count.description: Recipes left out because the KNOWN estimated cost of their missing ingredients is more than the food budget has left (unknown prices aren't counted).
over_budget_count.title: Over Budget Count

ReviewFlag.description: A field the user should check before saving (low confidence, missing, ambiguous).
ReviewFlag.title: ReviewFlag

estimated_total.description: Sum of line estimates of unbought items.
estimated_total.title: Estimated Total

picked_total.description: Sum of line estimates of bought items.
picked_total.title: Picked Total

unpriced_count.description: Unbought items without an estimated price.
unpriced_count.title: Unpriced Count

confidence.description: Heuristic consistency score of the pattern (not a probability).
confidence.title: Confidence

TransactionSummary.description: Totals for the same filters as GET /transactions (all pages).
